limits.html:
What this demo can and cannot do

The Excel export keeps

  • worksheet order and hidden sheets
  • column widths and row heights
  • merged cells
  • basic cell formatting
  • Yes/No/N/A validation dropdowns
  • conditional formatting
  • freeze panes

The Excel export does not support

  • embedded images
  • charts
  • macros (.xlsm)
  • pivot tables
  • form controls
  • web-portal questionnaires and PDFs

Fidelity is checked on this sample workbook only. It is not promised for every file.

Matching

Simple keyword matching, not AI. It misses reworded policies and says so. It never invents a control or certification, and it leaves unclear questions to the reviewer.

Data

Everything here is fictional. The demo runs in your browser, uses no AI service, and stores review choices only in this browser tab's session. Do not load real company files.
